title: Meliora
studio_context: January 2015 at EastWest, Ameraycan and The Village in Los Angeles and Riksmixningsverket in Stockholm; mixed by Andy Wallace.

drum_performances.name: The Nameless Ghoul on drums
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The record of the silver-masked era: From the Pinnacle to the Pit's snare on every beat, Cirice's four-to-the-bar kick under open hats (the 2016 Grammy for Best Metal Performance), Majesty's bars of 9/8 and 3/8 with the riff. The line-up credits a Nameless Ghoul on drums, and a session drummer is credited as well (not stored).

notable_moments.description: From the Pinnacle to the Pit: the snare on all four beats under ride eighths, the kick syncopated round it, and seven-sixteenth unison runs on snare and floor tom.
